text: How does the College Football Playoff work? 12-team field and rankings. The College Football Playoff is the postseason tournament that decides the national champion of NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision college football. A selection committee ranks teams during the regular season and chooses the teams that play in a single-elimination bracket of 12 teams.. What does over/under mean in betting? Georgia vs. Ole Miss total of 56.5 points. In betting, over/under is a wager on whether the combined final score of both teams will be higher (over) or lower (under) than a number the sportsbook sets in advance. That number is called the total. Bettors do not pick a winner.. Georgia visits Ole Miss on Saturday night in a top-10 Southeastern Conference matchup with playoff implications. Betting sites have posted an over/under line of 56.5 points for the game.. For the Georgia vs. Ole Miss game, the total is 56.5 points, according to the odds listed by CBS Sports. A bet on the over wins if the two teams together score 57 or more; a bet on the under wins if they score 56 or fewer. A half point means there can be no tie. The game is set for Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. ET at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium in Oxford, Mississippi, where No. 10 Ole Miss hosts No. 2 Georgia. Georgia is listed as a 3.5-point road favorite. Both teams have gone over more often than under this season: Georgia 6-2 to the over, Ole Miss 5-3.
